findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading (House vote 758, 66 ayes, 47 noes)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading of HB 958. The bill text (ratified version at https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) says county boards may process a voter registration application only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a US citizen. An application with no answer gets a notice and a 30-day window to return a citizenship statement under penalty of perjury. It also requires the State Board to create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database. The bill adds a citizenship question step at drivers license office registration. It does not set a photo-ID rule.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, motion 11 concur with Senate changes (House vote 801, 62 ayes, 47 noes)
findings.note: Voted aye to concur in the Senate version of HB 958, the final vote before ratification. The Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-08-17 (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958). Subjects as in the second-reading vote: citizenship statement on registration, removal of flagged non-citizens from voter rolls, deceased-voter list removal.
